articles.title: International naval exercises commence near eastern India
articles.summary: International naval exercises, MILAN 2026, have begun off Visakhapatnam, India. This large-scale event sees participation from over 70 nations, with the Indian Navy playing a significant role. These multinational exercises are crucial for enhancing interoperability, fostering maritime cooperation, and strengthening naval diplomacy among participating countries in the Indo-Pacific region.

articles.title: Global fraternity must join hands to tackle evolving maritime challenges: Defence Minister inaugurates Exercise MILAN in Vizag
articles.summary: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh urged the international community to effectively tackle complex and interconnected challenges at sea, emphasizing multilateralism. He called for collective action to ensure a safe, secure, and open global maritime commons. Singh highlighted India's commitment to a rules-based international order and responsible use of oceans for shared prosperity, essential for global stability and economic well-being.

articles.title: Coding Tricks Used in the C64 Game Seawolves
articles.summary: A game developer has announced the release of their first commercial game, "Seawolves," for the Commodore 64 platform. The author plans to publish a detailed account of the game's construction process, specifically aimed at coders. This initiative offers valuable insights into retro game development, explaining the technical aspects behind creating games on classic computing systems for fellow programming enthusiasts.

articles.title: DRDO conducts successful qualification test for Gaganyaan Drogue Parachute
articles.summary: India's Gaganyaan human spaceflight programme achieved a significant milestone with the successful qualification-level load test of the Drogue Parachute. Conducted at the Rail Track Rocket Sledge (RTRS) facility, this crucial test validates a critical component for safe crew module recovery. This progress brings India closer to its ambitious goal of sending astronauts to space, demonstrating robust indigenous capabilities in space technology and boosting national pride.

articles.title: Surya Kiran, Sarang Helicopter teams to perform over Jaipur's Jal Mahal on Feb 20, 22
articles.summary: The Indian Air Force's renowned Surya Kiran Aerobatic Team and Sarang Helicopter Display Team will stage breathtaking aerial displays over Jaipur's iconic Jal Mahal. This event showcases the IAF's precision and skill, offering spectacular performances for spectators. Such demonstrations boost public morale and inspire youth towards careers in the defence forces, highlighting India's air power capabilities.

articles.title: NxtGen AI deploys national-scale AI infrastructure in India with Vertiv and NVIDIA
articles.summary: NxtGen AI has deployed a national-scale sovereign AI factory in India, powered by NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs and Vertiv's data centre infrastructure. This strategic initiative significantly boosts India's indigenous AI capabilities, ensuring national data security and technological self-reliance. The facility represents a major step in enhancing domestic AI processing power, crucial for advancement across various national sectors.

articles.title: France and India hail growing ties as Modi hosts Macron
articles.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron began a three-day visit to India on February 17, 2026, in Mumbai. The visit celebrated India-France ties as a significant force for global stability. Discussions were primarily focused on bolstering bilateral cooperation, particularly in technology, reinforcing their strategic partnership amidst evolving international dynamics. This emphasizes India's growing diplomatic importance.

articles.title: Organigram Announces C$65.2 Million BAT Private Placement Investment in Connection with the Acquisition of Sanity Group
articles.summary: Organigram Global Inc., a company listed on both NASDAQ Global Select Market and TSX, operates through its wholly owned subsidiary, Organigram Inc. This subsidiary is a licensed entity specializing in the cultivation of cannabis and the manufacturing of various cannabis-derived products. The news highlights Organigram's operational scope and market positioning within the regulated cannabis industry, underscoring its role as a key player.

articles.title: How uncrewed narco subs could transform the Colombian drug trade
articles.summary: The Tayrona semisubmersible, a specialized naval asset, is located at Colombia's ARC Bolívar naval base in Cartagena. It currently sits in outdoor storage, visibly weathered by rain-streaked paint. Its state and proximity to an older, bulkier naval craft imply disuse or pending maintenance.
